name: Gif Puzzle Grid
description: Draggable tile grid where each tile shows a shuffled fragment of a randomly chosen image. Drag the tiles around the grid to reassemble the full picture.
contents: Grid of draggable image tiles forming a scrambled picture
Small hint line with an info icon below the grid
behavior: One image is picked at random from the options on mount
Tile fragments are shuffled across the tiles
Tiles are draggable with GridStack and pulse on hover and press
Grid background changes color on hover
Grid scales down to fit narrow screens

props.name: hintLabel
props.default: Use a 4×4 grid for the full image

editableByProps: Image options, image size, tile layout, grid size and cell size
Background, hover background and accent colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Pulse effect on tile hover and press

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Requires the gridstack npm package and its CSS, loaded by dynamic import
A random image is chosen from gifOptions on every mount
